panels.description: This table summarizes each room’s availability and AV readiness, displaying building and site, capacity, whether it is in use right now, the next booking, aggregated AV health (online, degraded, offline), the most recent telemetry seen for devices in the room, and recent utilization within the dashboard’s time range. Start by filtering to a site or building, then sort by AV health or In use now to prioritize interventions. Clicking a room opens its room overview with device-level detail and booking context. “No AV data” or many devices marked unknown usually means missing telemetry or a network issue; verify cabling, power, or upstream monitoring before reassigning meetings. Use the time range to compare peak vs. quiet periods and to spot underused rooms. When capacity mismatches or frequent conflicts appear, coordinate with scheduling to adjust bookings or suggest alternative rooms.

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position                                        AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno                                      AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset                                      AS parent_pos,
    0                                                  AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]   AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = ANY (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
root_per_pos AS (
  -- deepest reachable node per start_pos (even if never hits AVR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- joinable position (exists in eam_positions) that never resolves to a valid AVR room
  -- because chain ends or is broken, or ends at AVR but outside allowed room categories
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      -- chain ended (no parent) at a non-room root
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND NOT (rp.eqclass = 'AVR' AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')))
      -- or chain stopped because parent reference is broken
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_devices AS (
  -- devices with NULL position OR position not found in eam_positions
  SELECT d.equipmentno
  FROM eam_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno = d.position
  WHERE d.position IS NULL
     OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
),
status_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${status:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS status_arr
),
status_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${status:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all,
    ('__none__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '${status:raw}' = '__none__') AS want_none,
    ('__NO_ROOM_STATUS__' = ANY(status_arr)) AS want_no_room,
    array_remove(array_remove(status_arr, '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__'), '__none__') AS real_statuses
  FROM status_input
),
rooms_with_devices AS (
  -- --------- real AVR rooms that have devices ----------
  SELECT DISTINCT
    room.equipmentno         AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.category            AS RoomCategory,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM room.commissiondate) * 1000)::bigint      AS RoomCommissionDate,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  WHERE
    sf.is_all
    OR (sf.want_none AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
    OR (cardinality(sf.real_statuses) > 0 AND TRIM(room.assetstatus_display) = ANY(sf.real_statuses))

  UNION ALL

  -- --------- pseudo-room: No Position ----------
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar(64) AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No Room'                              AS ConferenceRoom,
    NULL::varchar                          AS RoomCategory,
    NULL::bigint                             AS RoomCommissionDate,
    'No Room'                              AS RoomStatus
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_position_devices)

  UNION ALL

  -- --------- pseudo-room: No Parent Position ----------
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'::varchar(64)   AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No Room'                              AS ConferenceRoom,
    NULL::varchar                          AS RoomCategory,
    NULL::bigint                             AS RoomCommissionDate,
    'No Room'                              AS RoomStatus
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_parent_positions)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__' THEN 'No position'
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   THEN 'No parent position'
      ELSE CONCAT(
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
      )
    END AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1)
    END AS part1_txt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2)
    END AS part2_txt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    END AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  CASE
    WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
    ELSE ConferenceRoomNo
  END AS ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomCategory,
  RoomCommissionDate,
  RoomStatus,
  CASE WHEN ConferenceRoomNo IS NOT NULL AND ConferenceRoomNo NOT LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN 1 END AS GIS
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo;

      WHEN r.ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   THEN 'No parent position'

        split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',

    CASE WHEN r.ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL ELSE split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) END AS part1_txt,

  FROM room_keys
),
room_order AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE ConferenceRoomNo
    END AS ConferenceRoomNoReal,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
        part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
        part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
        ConferenceRoomNo
    ) AS room_sort_rank
  FROM ranked
),
down AS (
  -- only traverse real rooms
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo,
    p.equipmentno,
    1                                                AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = r.ConferenceRoomNo
  WHERE r.ConferenceRoomNo NOT LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    d.ConferenceRoomNo,
    p.equipmentno,
    d.depth + 1,
    (d.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM down d
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE d.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (d.visited)
),
leafs AS (
  SELECT d.ConferenceRoomNo, d.equipmentno AS leaf_position
  FROM down d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions ch ON ch.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE ch.equipmentno IS NULL
)

-- --------- FINAL: union real-room devices + the 2 pseudo-room buckets ----------
SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  dev.equipmentno
FROM leafs l
JOIN room_order     ro  ON ro.ConferenceRoomNo = l.ConferenceRoomNo
JOIN eam_devices    dev ON dev.position        = l.leaf_position
JOIN eam_positions  pos ON pos.equipmentno     = l.leaf_position

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  dev.equipmentno
FROM room_order ro
JOIN no_parent_positions np ON true
JOIN eam_devices dev ON dev.position = np.start_pos
WHERE ro.ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  d.equipmentno
FROM room_order ro
JOIN no_position_devices d ON true
WHERE ro.ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'

ORDER BY room_sort_rank, ConferenceRoomNo, equipmentno;

-- PG_DEVICES (room ↔ device equipmentno) with stable room_sort_rank + No Room buckets
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position::varchar(64) AS position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
pos_joinable AS (
  -- only positions that exist in eam_positions (so recursion can start)
  SELECT dp.position
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = dp.position
),
climb_up AS (
  SELECT
    pj.position                                           AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar(64)                             AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar(64)                             AS parent_pos,
    0                                                     AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]      AS visited
  FROM pos_joinable pj
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = pj.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar(64),
    p.parentasset::varchar(64),
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno::varchar(64) = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
root_per_pos AS (
  -- deepest reachable node per start_pos (even if never hits AVR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb_up c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
no_parent_positions AS (
  -- joinable position that never resolves to a valid AVR room
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno::varchar(64) = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL
    AND (
      -- chain ended (no parent) at a non-room root
      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND NOT (rp.eqclass = 'AVR' AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')))
      -- or chain stopped because parent reference is broken
      OR (r.root_parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM eam_positions p2
            WHERE p2.equipmentno::varchar(64) = r.root_parent
          ))
    )
),
no_position_devices AS (
  -- devices with NULL position OR position not found in eam_positions
  SELECT d.equipmentno
  FROM eam_devices d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions p
    ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = d.position::varchar(64)
  WHERE d.position IS NULL
     OR p.equipmentno IS NULL
),
status_input AS (
  SELECT string_to_array('${status:csv}', ',')::varchar[] AS status_arr
),
status_filter AS (
  SELECT
    ('${status:raw}' = '__all') AS is_all,
    ('__none__' = ANY(status_arr) OR '${status:raw}' = '__none__') AS want_none,
    ('__NO_ROOM_STATUS__' = ANY(status_arr)) AS want_no_room,
    array_remove(array_remove(status_arr, '__NO_ROOM_STATUS__'), '__none__') AS real_statuses
  FROM status_input
),
rooms AS (
  -- real rooms filtered by status
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno::varchar(64) AS ConferenceRoomNo
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno::varchar(64) = pr.room_no
  CROSS JOIN status_filter sf
  WHERE
    sf.is_all
    OR (sf.want_none AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
    OR (cardinality(sf.real_statuses) > 0 AND TRIM(room.assetstatus_display) = ANY(sf.real_statuses))

  SELECT '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar(64)

  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)

        split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) || '-' ||
        split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
      )
    END AS ConferenceRoomNoFMT,
    CASE WHEN r.ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL ELSE split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) END AS part1_txt,

    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM room_keys
),
room_order AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    ConferenceRoomNoFMT,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
        part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
        part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
        ConferenceRoomNo
    ) AS room_sort_rank
  FROM ranked
),
-- walk down from rooms to leaf positions (ONLY real rooms)
down AS (
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo,
    p.equipmentno::varchar(64)                               AS equipmentno,
    1                                                       AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]        AS visited
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset::varchar(64) = r.ConferenceRoomNo
  WHERE r.ConferenceRoomNo NOT LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    d.ConferenceRoomNo,
    p.equipmentno::varchar(64),
    d.depth + 1,
    (d.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited

  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset::varchar(64) = d.equipmentno

    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (d.visited)
),
leafs AS (
  SELECT d.ConferenceRoomNo, d.equipmentno AS leaf_position
  FROM down d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions ch ON ch.parentasset::varchar(64) = d.equipmentno
  WHERE ch.equipmentno IS NULL
),
final_rows AS (
  -- real-room devices
  SELECT DISTINCT

    p.equipmentno::varchar(64)                             AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset::varchar(64)                             AS parent_pos,
    0                                                     AS depth,

  FROM pos_joinable pj
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = pj.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno::varchar(64),
    p.parentasset::varchar(64),
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (c.visited)
),

  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno::varchar(64) = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),

  -- deepest reachable node per start_pos (even if never hits AVR)
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos    AS root_pos,
    c.parent_pos AS root_parent
  FROM climb_up c
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),

  -- joinable position that never resolves to a valid AVR room
  SELECT r.start_pos
  FROM root_per_pos r
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno::varchar(64) = r.root_pos
  LEFT JOIN pos_to_room pr ON pr.start_pos = r.start_pos
  WHERE pr.start_pos IS NULL

      (r.root_parent IS NULL AND NOT (rp.eqclass = 'AVR' AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')))
      -- or chain stopped because parent reference is broken

    ConferenceRoomNo,
    ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE ConferenceRoomNo
    END AS ConferenceRoomNoReal,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
        part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
        part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
        ConferenceRoomNo
    ) AS room_sort_rank
  FROM ranked
),

  -- only traverse real rooms
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo,
    p.equipmentno,
    1                                                AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = r.ConferenceRoomNo
  WHERE r.ConferenceRoomNo NOT LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%'

    d.ConferenceRoomNo,

  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  dev.equipmentno
FROM leafs l
JOIN room_order     ro  ON ro.ConferenceRoomNo = l.ConferenceRoomNo
JOIN eam_devices    dev ON dev.position        = l.leaf_position
JOIN eam_positions  pos ON pos.equipmentno     = l.leaf_position

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  dev.equipmentno
FROM room_order ro
JOIN no_parent_positions np ON true
JOIN eam_devices dev ON dev.position = np.start_pos
WHERE ro.ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'

UNION ALL

  ro.ConferenceRoomNo,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ro.room_sort_rank,
  d.equipmentno
FROM room_order ro
JOIN no_position_devices d ON true
WHERE ro.ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'

ORDER BY room_sort_rank, ConferenceRoomNo, equipmentno;

  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__'::varchar(64) AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No Room'                              AS ConferenceRoom,
    NULL::varchar                          AS RoomCategory,
    NULL::date                             AS RoomCommissionDate,
    'No Room'                              AS RoomStatus
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_position_devices)

  UNION ALL

  -- --------- pseudo-room: No Parent Position ----------
  SELECT
    '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'::varchar(64)   AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    'No Room'                              AS ConferenceRoom,
    NULL::varchar                          AS RoomCategory,
    NULL::date                             AS RoomCommissionDate,
    'No Room'                              AS RoomStatus
  FROM status_filter sf
  WHERE (sf.is_all OR sf.want_no_room)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM no_parent_positions)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_POSITION__' THEN 'No position'
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo = '__NO_ROOM_NO_PARENT__'   THEN 'No parent position'
      ELSE CONCAT(
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
        split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
      )
    END AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1)
    END AS part1_txt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2)
    END AS part2_txt,
    CASE
      WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
      ELSE split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    END AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  CASE
    WHEN ConferenceRoomNo LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN NULL
    ELSE ConferenceRoomNo
  END AS ConferenceRoomNoReal,
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomCategory,
  RoomCommissionDate,
  RoomStatus,
  CASE WHEN ConferenceRoomNo IS NOT NULL AND ConferenceRoomNo NOT LIKE '__NO_ROOM_%' THEN 1 END AS GIS
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo;
